versions.changelog:
Initial release of Design System Hub.

- Create and operate a local hub to collect, document, and demonstrate multiple design systems.
- Initialize a local React/Vite service with a built-in template and four starter design systems.
- Add new design systems from screenshots, URLs, or text—automatically extracting full design tokens, components, and documentation.
- Export each system’s full documentation, token JSON, DESIGN.md, standalone HTML, and browsable APIs.
- Strictly isolate entries to prevent cross-system contamination; never overwrite unrelated files.
- Fully supports both English and Chinese for user-facing content.
